sourceFacts: The official public page specifies a 3-by-3 grid, five fixed paylines, wild substitution, three matching symbols and a left-side 1x–5x multiplier reel.
unresolved: The observed own wild prize plus 5x permits a 500x independent base bound, while help advertises 375x; provider award restrictions are unverified.
The provider payline chart and probabilities are unverified. X2 uses independently fair colors, a pre-spin hold control and an independent three-attempt limit.
